svg.text: Leshy2 - two-board clamshell: complete layout with all external interfaces + mounting holes
To scale, ~75x150 mm per board. SMA = grey squares on the top edge; mounting holes = ringed dots at 4 corners (M2.5, aligned both boards).
Side view - a slice through the thickness
(the device edge-on: width across, thickness downward)
FRONT - the side you look at
BACK - removable lid; pop to swap the 18650 cells
ant: C5-5G nRF#3 SA868 LoRa Si4732
All external interfaces present: display+touch, 9x SMA (4 front / 5 back), USB-C x2, microSD, 3.5mm jack, 2x Grove, IR, speaker, mic, master, battery.
Controls in their locked positions (README S5): D-pad+BACK+OPT front; encoder+F1/F2+jack+IR left edge; PTT+STOP+Grove right edge. Service (RST/BOOT/SD/USB) inside.
